candidate.title: Chem-seq
candidate.scope: Assigned Illumina Chem-seq row, including its separate in vivo (living-cell ligand exposure) and in vitro (ligand capture from fixed cell lysate) alternatives. Both end at extracted enriched DNA. The shared captions are separate operations for each route, without pooling. The left identification thumbnail describes the target; adjacent MPE-seq, DamID text and PD-Seq/Protein-Protein Interactions belong to other rows. The generic schematic is resolved using the cited Anders JQ1 implementation, without extending this preparation to every Chem-seq adaptation. The eventual DNA sequencing library represents recovered ligand-associated genomic regions; library construction and sequencing are paper-reported downstream interpretation, not additional drawn steps.
